power.model: every informative cohort a paired cell (an upper bound); the reference covers with p_ref, the combination with p_ref + delta; concordance c: P(both) = (1-c) p_a p_ref + c min(p_a, p_ref); icc: within-cluster copy probability; 'power' = the fraction that reads a loss (z < -2, or a CI lower end <= -margin when a margin is set); at delta = 0 it is the chance of failing a combination that loses nothing

gate.rule: per combination vs eta and vs epsilon: loss if z < -2; underpowered below 30 paired cells or 10 clusters (sraging.scoring.paired.gate)
